run_average_network_fictitious_play: run average-network fictitious play with DQN agents on a mean-field game
create_dqn_agents: create DQN best-response RL agents for each player in a mean-field game
create_mfg_environment: create mean-field game environments with uniform initial distribution policy
evaluate_nash_convergence: evaluate nash convergence using nash_conv metric on the fictitious play policy
log_training_metrics: log training metrics including best response values and nash_conv per iteration
